# Kontekstual

> Eksperimen bahasa pemrograman dengan sintaks Indonesia, interpreter Rust, browser playground, dokumentasi, dan panduan agent coding.

Kontekstual is an experimental programming language whose syntax uses structured Indonesian instructions. It is not unrestricted natural-language programming.

## Start here
- Home: https://dotkonteks.pages.dev/  (audience paths, live examples, FAQ, classroom guidance)
- For beginners: https://dotkonteks.pages.dev/#untuk-pemula

- For parents: https://dotkonteks.pages.dev/#untuk-orangtua
- Browser playground: https://dotkonteks.pages.dev/coba/
- Documentation index: https://dotkonteks.pages.dev/docs/

- Command and value reference: https://dotkonteks.pages.dev/docs/reference/
- AI and agent guide: https://dotkonteks.pages.dev/agent/
- Full AI-readable guide: https://dotkonteks.pages.dev/llms-full.txt
- GitHub repository: https://github.com/flessan/kontekstual

## Core facts
- Source files use the .konteks extension.
- Instructions end with a period.
- Text literals use quotation marks.
- Blocks are structured through indentation.
- Main interpreter: Rust.
- Browser playground: JavaScript compatibility runtime for experimentation.
- Supported subset includes output, variables, arithmetic, comparisons, conditionals, and Selama loops.
- Function definitions, modules, interactive input, loop-control statements, and native executable generation are not implemented in the current prototype.
- Rust uses signed 64-bit integers; the browser runtime uses JavaScript safe integers.
- Both interpreter and browser runtime limit total loop iterations to 100,000 per execution.
- The playground stores source in browser localStorage; no code is sent to a server.
- The playground offers an Indonesian formatter, syntax highlighting, example programs, and separate output/problem panels.

## For agents
Read the documentation at /llms-full.txt and /agent/llms-full.txt before generating code. Treat the current interpreter and tests as the source of truth for implemented syntax. Do not invent unsupported language features.
